replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: Last year, I used AI tools to check my budget calculations and solve simple algebra problems. It helped me quickly verify results without frustration. I found it reliable for quick checks but not for deep understanding.
replies.How would you explain, step by step, how: To solve a second-order equation like ax² + bx + c = 0, first move all terms to one side. Then calculate the discriminant (b² - 4ac). If positive, two real solutions; zero, one solution; negative, complex. Use the quadratic formula: x = [-b ± √(b²-4ac)] / (2a).

To find stationary points, take the derivative f'(x), set it equal to zero, and solve for x. Plug those x-values back into f(x) to get y-coordinates. Check if they’re maxima or minima using the second derivative test.
